plan: PLAN.md, research Phase D, and the Phase 2 error-analysis item moved to it

model.maps_from: v2-final-seed0 (shipped EfficientNet-B0 v2, checkpoint checked by weights hash 538b9a8188528706 from results/phase2/overnight/v2/final_models.json in the volume)
model.layer: features[-1], the last block: 7x7 at 224 px, so maps are coarse
model.preprocessing: the evaluation transform: resize 224, center crop 224, ImageNet normalization

selection.worst_misses: client test split; for each true class, images the shipped ensemble misclassifies, lowest ensemble probability of the true class first, up to 20 per class
selection.most_ood: client test split; the 20 images with the highest Mahalanobis score (mean over the 3 seeds' saved scores from the Phase 2 v2 drift run, PCA by method D)
selection.overlap: an image in both lists appears once, with both reasons

maps: Grad-CAM for the ensemble's predicted class and for the true class, from seed 0
reproduction_gate: seed 0's softmax on every selected image must match its probabilities in results/phase2/analysis_look/predictions.csv.gz within 0.001, or the run stops before any map

checks.randomization: per image, Spearman correlation between seed 0's predicted-class map and that of a fully re-initialized copy (Adebayo et al. 2018); 0.5 or more is flagged and not interpreted
checks.seed_agreement: per image, mean Spearman correlation between seed 0's predicted-class map and seeds 1 and 2's maps for the same class; reported, not used to filter

error_analysis.confusion_by_client: the ensemble's confusion matrix on each client's test images, from the committed predictions
error_analysis.confusion_by_skin_type: at Buenos Aires and PAD-UFES-20, per Fitzpatrick type with at least 100 labelled images; smaller types get counts only (98 images of types IV to VI in total)

outputs.mlflow: an HTML worksheet artifact, with license and attribution per image
outputs.table: workspace.cdm.gold_review_worksheet, one row per selected image, with a blank reviewer_notes column
outputs.repo: results/research/d_review/worksheet.csv (IDs and values only, no images) and results.json

status: maps are for a human reviewer; nothing here is called reviewed until a reviewer fills reviewer_notes
